race.comment: SHINY DIAMOND (14) resumes. She ran a distant second on debut back in April but the winner there is handy and she should have taken plenty from it. Query that this is 1100m having debuted over 1400m but she can take this out. SEALAND (13) was just fair first up over this trip at Pakenham Synthetic when in the market. Her debut last campaign was good and she can improve sharply back to turf here. BOSS BUNDLE (2) resumes off a long break from Hong Kong. He didn't fire over there but has jumped out quite well and the booking of Shinn is very interesting. Watch the market closely. SERVENIA (16) ran a good third on resumption at Bendigo and any improvement sees her firmly in the mix. LOST THE PLOT (11) is third up and will give a sight.
